data.title: 不知火舞 · 夏祭折扇与苹果糖
data.description: 【乡镇夏祭·夜】不知火舞穿着红白浴衣站在苹果糖摊前，折扇轻轻挡住被糖浆黏住的手指；她把刚挑好的苹果糖递向镜头，红白灯笼映出高马尾和明朗笑容。
data.action: 苹果糖摊前用折扇解开黏住的手指，再把亮晶晶的糖果递向镜头
data.lighting: warm lantern light under the night sky
data.mood: 不知火流继承人的轻快祭典
data.promptProse: Mai Shiranui stands at the town festival's candy-apple stall in a modest red-and-white floral yukata and dark obi. She uses her folding fan to shield a syrup-sticky fingertip, then offers the glossy apple toward the viewer with a bright smile. The horizontal medium portrait includes lanterns and nearby visitors behind her high ponytail. Warm night lantern light highlights apple glaze and fan folds, with softer stall shadows framing her hands.
